source.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 185872

units_tab.details: Added to control whether units are allowed to be auto-converted. The release notes say ‘Never (Gaia Aggressive)’ may be used to let Gaia units act aggressively. Even with ‘Never’ or ‘Never (Gaia Aggressive)’, some units may still convert if they have the Auto-Convert task; sheep and monuments are the examples given.
Added to the Units tab to allow changing a unit’s state. The release notes do not enumerate the dropdown values.

condition_fields.details: A new checkbox on the multiplayer Object is Visible condition. The release notes do not specify its default or give additional semantics.

options.label: All
options.details: Remains unchanged and is the default value.

options.label: Previously Unmodified
options.details: Restricts the effect to units on the map that have not previously been modified by a Modify Object Attribute effect.

options.label: Previously Modified
options.details: Restricts the effect to units on the map that have previously been modified by a Modify Object Attribute effect.

object_visible_multiplayer.details: A new Scenario Editor checkbox for Object is Visible (MP). This editor addition is recorded separately; the release notes do not establish a new AoE2ScenarioParser method parameter.

stop_object.details: Stop Object triggers now correctly clear building production queues.

freeze_object.details: Freeze Object triggers now correctly clear building production queues.

task_object.details: Task Object using the Stop action now correctly clears building production queues.

task_object.label: Unload All
task_object.details: Renamed and now works as intended, the same as the regular Unload effect.

task_object.label: Ungarrison Specific
task_object.details: Renamed; behavior is unchanged. It instructs the selected object to leave the unit it is currently garrisoned inside.
